data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2232 recorded an overall prior-year reserve strengthening in 2019 of approximately GBP 12.8m (gross), driven by adverse redevelopment on older underwriting years. The movement was driven principally by loss reserve strengthening in Treaty Property and Third-party Liability classes, with named typhoon events (notably Typhoon Jebi and 2019 Pacific typhoons Lekima, Faxai and Hagibis) cited as contributing factors. The report also states a net adverse prior year development of GBP 11.6m (net of reinsurance).

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding 2018 column). Gross prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 43) because the notes/narrative state only a net prior-year development figure (GBP 11.6m net of reinsurance) on page 24. The triangle is presented in GBP 000; figures were converted to millions. There is a small mismatch between some note totals and the balance sheet presentation (triangle-derived gross reserves total 391.88m vs balance sheet 396.53m), likely presentation/rounding differences. Prior-year development figure provided here is gross and derived from the triangle; narrative provides a net amount only.
